changes.details: New tile 'Reorder your usual from {merchant}' added for premium_member role. Previously, premium_member saw the same Order Again rail as member.
New transition: home → cart via home.accelerator_tile (role_gated to premium_member). Skips the reorder_review screen entirely.
New state 'waived' added — shows '$0.00 (Premium)' for premium_member role. Previously fee was always shown at face value with no role variation.
New 'Quick place' button surfaced for premium_member when order total ≤ $50.
